rationale: The working evaluation's primary limiter was unproven willingness to pay a premium over low-cost compliance trackers and free portals. Version 4 changes the customer, payer, paid event, control point, distribution and economic engine: an EPR adviser or packaging-design partner operates a required evidence-release gate and pays a licence plus governed-case usage, while country exports become a by-product. This is a structural redesign rather than wording polish because all six fingerprint fields and every economics field change. It does not assert a partner commitment, price, margin, savings, case volume or validation; those remain explicit unknowns to test.
